item.title: fix(discord): upload-file silently drops a caption (#124255)
item.summary: fix(discord): upload-file silently drops a caption (#124255) * fix(discord,msteams): upload-file silently drops a caption Both channels accept `media` as an alias for the uploaded file, so a send-shaped call reaches `upload-file` carrying its text in `caption`. Discord read only `message`/`content` and MS Teams read only `text`/`content`/`message`, so that text was dropped and the file landed with no message at all. Accept `caption` as the lowest-precedence alias on both channels, matching the WhatsApp and Slack upload paths. An explicitly empty higher-precedence value still wins, so existing callers keep their behavior. The MS Teams reader is scoped to `upload-file` because the other actions carry their own text field. * refactor: narrow this PR to the Discord channel Microsoft Teams keeps the same defect and the same fix shape, but a Teams after-fix delivery or activity trace is not reachable without a live tenant, so that half is deferred to its own change rather than blocking the Discord repair that already has a production-boundary trace.
